catalogDefinition.scope: Current food and nonalcoholic catalog for Bakeshop at 100 E. Fairfax Street, Falls Church, Virginia, including same-day pickup and current advance-order products.
catalogDefinition.rationale: The official menu hub currently links the restaurant-issued Menu_July2026 PDF, which is a valid three-page PDF and fully enumerates cupcakes, configurable breakfast sandwiches, drinks, cakes, pies, refrigerated desserts, breads, cookies, treats, and macarons for Bakeshop locations including Falls Church. The official cake page enumerates the advance cake catalog, the Falls Church request page is its location-specific order presentation, and the restaurant-linked Toast page enumerates the current same-day Falls Church pickup catalog. These surfaces are complementary and overlap substantially. The four existing result products intentionally represent these complete catalog families, so the binding boundary requires no additional product identity beyond them.

items.rationale: The current official PDF's Breakfast builder lists Bacon and Ham as separate choices under 'Choose Your Protein'; it does not sell a product named BaconHam or Bacon/Ham. The frozen key is a flattened modifier-list extraction artifact. The current breakfast catalog remains represented by official-full-menu-catalog and toast-falls-church-catalog.

allergenAssessment.notes: Classifying the flattened text does not establish any allergen absence, may-contain absence, or cross-contact status.

items.rationale: The current official PDF contains a BREAD section with named loaf products and notes that individual slices change seasonally; it contains no independently sellable product named DAILYBREAD. allergenAssessment.notes: The section-label resolution makes no item-level ingredient, allergen-negative, may-contain, or cross-contact conclusion.
